text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I see! You got a fan letter. No 
wonder you looked even happier than 
usual...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
K-Keep your voice down! ...Ugh, is it 
really that obvious on my face?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, probably more than Dober thinks. 
So, what did it say?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Um... apparently they saw me in the 
Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: And so... Well, they said it looked cool.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey, what are you laughing at...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Ah... it just brought back old memories.

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~! Amazing, amazing! Both the races 
and the concerts are totally explosive!

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So cool! So this is... the Twinkle 
Series...!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...I wanna dance like that too! Run an 
amazing race and do a super cool dance!"

text_block_list.name: Young Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm sure you can do it, Dober. I'm 
so excited to see that performance!

text_block_list.name: Young Dober
text_block_list.text:
Mmph! Ryan's dancing with me too! We'll 
both wear sparkly outfits, and thenâ

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Stop, stop, stop...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Th-That was a long time ago...! Stop it 
already... Jeez!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry, you were just so cute I 
couldn't help it. Anyway, what I meant to 
say was...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I went from being the one looking up to 
others, to the one being looked up to... 
That's what hit me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
............ ...To be on the side that's 
admired, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...There's still so much I can't do. Even 
so... I wonder if there are some things 
I've gotten better at...?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I think... I've answered what Dober 
felt back then.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ryan...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I have to do my best too! I've gotta dance 
nicely together with everyone in a 
"sparkly outfit"!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
G-Geez! That's why I told you to stop 
bringing up the past...!
